features.description: Dress the navigation arc (operator-side screen on its stern face) and the captain's chair to the sprites' finish with the spire's light baked into a lightmap UV set; capture Bow at rest, 0.99c, the first guided stop and the navigation zoom; bench. Dressed props export to bridge_props.glb (WebP textures, lightmap <= 2048^2); their blockout copies leave ship.glb.
